lineage.strategy: Add a product-award signal distinct from filing-level mix and capital-allocation evidence.

observations.fact: Mobileye announced a Driver Monitoring System production award with a leading U.S. automaker, targeted for 2027 start of production and expected to span millions of vehicles across multiple models and model years.
The DMS is designed to run alongside ADAS perception on the EyeQ6L system-on-chip, extending content on an existing ADAS program rather than requiring a separate compute platform.

risks.risk: The issuer does not disclose customer identity, contract value, unit economics or guaranteed production volumes; targeted 2027 production remains forward-looking.

unknowns.unknown: Revenue per vehicle, take rate, margin contribution and binding volume commitments remain undisclosed.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed product-content and pipeline evidence; keep volume and economics unscored until Alpha has contractual or realized data.
